title: The Long Way Home
intro: After 24 days on the road, The Long Way Around comes to an end. The final journey begins in Munich, crosses the Atlantic through Atlanta, and continues home to Fort Worth — completing a loop that stretched across countries, mountain passes, lakes, railways and thousands of miles.

stops.name: Munich Airport
stops.description: Begin the journey home from Munich after the final night in Europe.

stops.name: Atlanta
stops.description: Return to the United States and connect in Atlanta for the final leg home.

stops.name: Fort Worth
stops.description: Arrive home in Fort Worth, bringing The Long Way Around to a close.
